glosses: fiber / fibre (single elongated piece of material)

examples.en: Is eating too much fiber bad for you?

examples.text: O doutor me disse para comer mais fibra.
examples.en: The doctor told me to eat more fiber.

examples.text: Esta bicicleta de fibra de carbono é incrivelmente leve.
examples.en: This carbon fiber bicycle is incredibly lightweight.

examples.text: Os músculos são feitos de centenas de fibras finas.
examples.en: Muscles are made of hundreds of thin fibers.
